items.title: Congress’ landmark law protecting pregnant workers is unconstitutional, court holds
items.summary: The decision renders the Pregnant Workers Fairness Act unenforceable against the state of Texas, but other employers must still comply with the law, observers cautioned.

items.title: Trump administration puts more than 1.5K contractors on notice over E-Verify compliance
items.summary: The federal government gave the firms 30 days to respond to its notice to provide proof of compliance.

items.title: AI, manager burnout and workforce mental health in 2027
items.summary: Two emerging trends for 2027: AI is changing work as manager strain takes a toll on teams.

items.title: Executives get more AI training than other workers, hurting adoption, report finds
items.summary: The disparity may explain why some employers see a “stalled transformation” within their enterprises, according to researchers at Marsh.
